# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The following versions of this project are currently supported with security updates:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| latest  | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, **please do not open a public GitHub issue**.

Instead, report it privately by contacting the maintainers directly via Telegram: [@vdkfrost](https://t.me/vdkfrost).

Please include as much of the following information as possible to help us understand and resolve the issue quickly:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- The affected package(s) and version(s)
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Any proof-of-concept or exploit code (if applicable)

We will acknowledge receipt of your report as soon as possible and keep you informed of our progress toward a fix. We ask that you give us reasonable time to address the issue before any public disclosure.

## Scope

This security policy covers all packages published under the `@telegram-apps` scope that are maintained in this repository.
